title: The Hydroponic Crop Charter
logline: A station food growers union strikes over unviable seedling batches, unaware that the station farm manager pledged exclusive crop patent rights to an off-system cartel to settle municipal bailout debt.

roles.description: Superintendent of the station's orbital greenhouse rings; exhausted, numbers-driven, and cornered by corporate bondholders.
Chief steward of the hydroponics labor syndicate; stubborn, dirt-under-the-fingernails, and protective of family allotments.
A corporate collection auditor representing off-system food syndicates holding the station's agricultural debts.
Massive rotating hydroponic tiers providing fresh greens and algae protein for the station.
The pressurized seed vault and distribution terminal where harvest yields are weighed.
The tight-knit collective of orbital farmers, soil tenders, and algae vat workers.

public_situation: Algae tenders and greenhouse mechanics stage shift walkouts across {role:greenhouse_dome_ring} after management cuts seed rations by forty percent.
private_truth: The farm manager sold off the station's heirloom seed patents to an off-system agricultural cartel to cover defaulted habitat utility bonds, locking farmers into sterile annual leases.

beats.public_change: Management shuts off irrigation pumps in protest tiers as the union gathers outside {role:central_grain_silo}.

missions.reason: He pays an outside pilot to haul pure silicate from the asteroid belt to reinforce algae tank filtration beds before the crop dies.
missions.private_fact: He knows the silicate won't fix the shortfall because the new corporate seed stock is engineered to fail without expensive proprietary nutrients.

beats.public_change: {role:agri_cartel_enforcer} arrives with private bailiffs, demanding full control of the germination vaults.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to purchase supplementary germination stimulants from freeport merchants before the cartel inspects output.
missions.private_fact: The stimulants are banned station substances that poison soil beds after two harvests but force short-term compliance.

beats.public_change: Union workers breach the silo records office, discovering financial liens attached to every seedling tray.

missions.reason: She pays the pilot to scan the silo's trade transponder to verify whether the seed patent dockets were transferred to an offshore corporate account.
missions.private_fact: She mortgaged her family's greenhouse pod to buy seed units that were secretly owned by the cartel the entire time.

beats.public_change: Tensions boil over as union workers barricade the seed vaults and {role:agri_cartel_enforcer} orders ventilation shutdown.

missions.reason: She begs the pilot to rush the uncovered patent contract to the station magistrate before the cartel seals the airlocks.
missions.private_fact: If the magistrate refuses the petition, the union will flood the vats with brine, destroying the entire system food supply.

player_choice.prompt: Holding proof that the farm manager mortgaged the station's food security to settle municipal bonds, the pilot must decide whether to void the corporate lease, force a labor compromise, or enforce the cartel debt.

options.label: Deliver the patent records to the magistrate to void the predatory seed seizure and back the union
Broker a compromise allowing the cartel crop lease while guaranteeing grower wage floors
Sell the contract copies to the cartel enforcer to crush the strike and collect an enforcement fee

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the patent proof to the magistrate.
resolutions.summary: The magistrate annuls the seed lien as an illegal public hazard. {role:growers_syndicate} regains seed sovereignty, while {role:farm_manager} is dismissed.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot delivered the contract proof that broke a corporate monopoly over a station's food crop.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot brokers a labor compromise.
resolutions.summary: The union signs a rolling tenant lease with the cartel. Work resumes, but {role:union_grower}'s members become indebted sharecroppers on their own rings.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot mediated a bitter greenhouse strike that ended in farmers leasing sterile seeds from a corporate cartel.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the records to the cartel enforcer.
resolutions.summary: {role:agri_cartel_enforcer} floods the greenhouse with security enforcers. Strikers are blacklisted, and food prices double under direct cartel management.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot backed corporate food enforcers who crushed a greenhouse union and seized the station grain silos.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot never intervenes or abandons the petition.
resolutions.summary: The union poisons the algae tanks in protest. Cartel security evacuates the dome rings, leaving {system} dependent on expensive emergency rations.

loose_threads.detail: A regional commodities exchange registered futures contracts for sterile grain cultivars six months before the harvest failed.
The fertilizer canisters carry chemical registry codes matching banned synthetic defoliants shipped from an offshore chemical plant.

radio_hooks: Hydroponic tenders stage wildcat strike across orbital greenhouse sectors.
Station nutritional board warns emergency food paste rations may be instituted.
Off-system agricultural finance houses deny predatory lending allegations in local farming belts.

voice_direction.farm_manager: Exhausted, monotone, and habitually reaches for bureaucratic accounting spreadsheets. Speaks like someone drowning in red ink.
voice_direction.union_grower: Loud, raw, and fiercely protective of her people. Refuses to brook accounting double-talk.
voice_direction.agri_cartel_enforcer: Polished, emotionless, and regards food production strictly as an enforceable debt portfolio.
